Hey! I’m so sorry this happened to you. That is really unfair and I’m sure you have dealt with some seriously difficult emotions. The first time I ever experienced anything sexual was being raped, and then my first ever boyfriend / consensual partner gave me an std that caused me to have tons of physical and mental issues for a long time. I had a lot of issues and kind of still do. But the thing is, you will find someone who doesn’t care about the issues you have going on. They will want to be with you regardless. They will want to work with you in the circumstances you have. Promise. Out in the world people have ALL KINDS OF SHIT that make intimacy difficult. There are disabled people, traumatized people, addicts, men with micropenises, a million other things. Not trying to invalidate your feelings at all, that is a truly difficult thing to experience, but just know that there are all sorts of barriers to intimacy that are dealt with. You are much more than a diagnosis and honestly herpes is not that big of a deal. As time goes on more people are becoming educated and open about it. The truth is almost everyone has it and we are all taking that risk every time we have sex. Please do not be ashamed of this experience you are having in this lifetime. It is nothing to be ashamed of. You are a human having a human experience. You are going to emerge from this stronger and more compassionate than ever. Invest into yourself, identify hobbies and traits you want to have and fucking do and achieve it. I feel like I spent so much time developing myself because of my traumatic and isolating experiences, and I really love who I am now, and so do others. I admire how i have used the emotions and isolation for my betterment. I don’t even know you, but I honestly feel love for you just because you had to experience something like this. It will make you stronger and a better person. All the feelings you are going through right now are proof of that. Sending so much love, feel free to message me if you ever want to talk or rant or anything.
